titre: Prix de dépôt en décharge aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Dollars par tonne, moyennes nationales 2023 et 2024

2023.texte: National average MSW landfill tipping fee: $62.28 per ton (2024), up from $56.80 per ton (2023).

2024.texte: The national average landfill tipping fee reached $62.28 per ton in 2024, a 10% increase from $56.80 in 2023

Sites publics 2024.texte: now average $74.75 per ton, compared to $55.89 per ton at public sites

Sites privés 2024.texte: Private landfills (34 % of the total surveyed) now average $74.75 per ton, compared to $55.89 per ton at public sites
